info.title: SDKWork Partner App API
info.description: User-facing API for the SDKWork partner join (伙伴计划) marketing module: public partner program catalog, join applications, application tracking, and invite-code validation. Applications are reviewed on the management surface (sdkwork-partner-backend-api).

tags.name: join
tags.description: Partner join (伙伴计划) marketing module.

get.description: Public partner program information: level catalog (join fees, commission pools, benefits), global commission rules, and the join policy summary. Powers the public landing page.

post.description: Submits a partner join application for the current session user. Idempotent per applicant: a repeat submission with no active SUBMITTED application creates a new record; an active SUBMITTED application returns a conflict. Invite codes are validated at submit time and lock the inviter partner.

409.description: Conflict (an active SUBMITTED application already exists or the invite code is invalid)

get.description: Lists the current session user's join applications (including rejected/cancelled history), newest first.

post.description: Cancels (withdraws) the current session user's own application. Only allowed on SUBMITTED applications owned by the caller.

403.description: Forbidden (not the owner or not cancellable)

get.description: Validates a partner invite code for the apply form. Returns the inviter partner name and level when valid; an ACTIVE partner with a non-deleted invite code is required.
Resolves the partner bound to the signed-in user and returns identity, network size, and money summary (available/frozen/earned/withdrawn, minimum withdrawal).

get.summary: List my team with per-member earnings
get.description: Pages the caller's partner subtree (depth 1..N) with each member's level, direct team size, customer count, lifetime commission, and available balance.
Pages commission allocations received by the caller: source event, base amount, ratio, amount, level offset, and settlement status.
Pages the caller's withdrawal applications, newest first.

post.description: Creates a withdrawal application for the signed-in partner. Minimum amount, available balance, and the account hold are enforced server-side.

value.description: Display value of the benefit (e.g. 10 qualified leads per month).

sort.description: Display sort order within the level benefit list.

joinFee.description: Join fee amount for this level.

customerRevenueRatio.description: Customer revenue commission pool ratio (percent, e.g. 20.00).

joinFeeCommissionRatio.description: Join fee commission pool ratio (percent, e.g. 10.00).

benefits.description: Structured benefit (权益) ladder granted by this level.

profitMarginRatio.description: Platform gross profit margin ratio (percent, default 40.00): customer revenue commissions are profit-based.

joinFeePolicy.description: Join fee policy summary text (display copy).

levels.description: Active partner level catalog (join fees, pools, benefits).

subjectName.description: Subject name (organization name when applicantType=ORGANIZATION; personal name otherwise).

targetLevelNo.description: Target (aspirational) level number; the final level is decided by the reviewer.

inviteCode.description: Optional inviter invite code; validated at submit time.
Invite code submitted with the application (original input).

inviterPartnerId.description: Inviter partner id locked at submit time (null = no invite code).

reviewComment.description: Review comment (approval note or rejection reason).

approvedPartnerId.description: Partner record created on approval (closed loop reference).

valid.description: Whether the invite code is valid.

partnerName.description: Inviter partner display name (empty when invalid).

levelNo.description: Inviter partner level number (null when invalid).
